exchangeDetails.name: NovaDAX
exchangeDetails.description: NovaDAX is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange registered in Brazil. Is NovaDAX safe? NovaDAX security rating is low with 33% security score.

topRisks.content: The absence of CCSS certification leaves crypto custody controls unvalidated, increasing the risk of undetected security gaps.
Missing penetration testing leaves the system without independent validation, increasing the likelihood that hidden security flaws remain undetected.
Without a Proof of Reserve audit, user asset backing cannot be independently verified, elevating transparency and solvency risks.
